provenance.operatorRationale: CourtRegisterSubscriptions/index.js:21-34 has four early exits — a falsy body, no `nowSubscriptions` key, no register defendants, and no court-register subscriptions — and every one of them returns the fragment UNCHANGED, with `matchedSubscriptions` still the empty array the constructor gave it. OutboundCourtRegister/index.js:17 then returns null and the hearing produces no register at all. Each exit must be reachable, and the port must be able to tell "reference data said there are none" from "reference data did not answer" — which the legacy cannot, because ReferenceDataService swallows the failure and returns null (defect C3's territory).
